reason: If it's Apache-2.0 and runs on my own boxes, I'd self-host it and never pay for Cloud. I'd maybe try the free version, but Claude Code and GitHub Actions already cover most of the scheduled-agent stuff.
objection: Pre-alpha from one developer, and Cloud means your server firing schedules against my team's machines and agent logins. I won't hand that to a solo project.
would_change_my_mind: A self-hostable server with the phone app working against it, plus a few months of real teams running it without breakage.
